baseline_models.mechanism: A spoken creed names the sole sovereign and then becomes an upright, sustained organizing line for conduct.

activation_trace.role: The belief-or-doctrine branch makes the utterance a publicly stated governing commitment rather than bare sound.
Lordship and sovereignty supply the commitment's governing authority.
The worshiped-one branch fixes the declaration's object as exclusive devotion.
Upright balance supplies the lived continuation introduced by thumma.

changed_reading.before: A profession of faith is followed by generic moral perseverance.
changed_reading.after: The profession installs one governing allegiance, and istiqama is the continuing bodily and practical alignment that makes the saying true.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: تتنزل عليهم الملائكة ألا تخافوا ولا تحزنوا وأبشروا
baseline_models.mechanism: A descending angelic presence meets expected harm and grief's inner roughness with an announcement that visibly opens joy.

activation_trace.role: Descent and settling make the angelic event an arriving presence upon the steadfast.
The angel branch identifies the descending agents while retaining the root's forceful, coherent agency.
Fear as expectation of harm marks the threatened forward horizon that the message clears.
Grief as psychic roughness marks the burdened inner terrain that the message smooths.
Good news that opens the skin with joy makes reassurance somatically manifest rather than merely informational.

changed_reading.before: Angels deliver consoling information about a future reward.
changed_reading.after: Their descent is a present encounter that reorders the believer's threatened horizon and grief-marked interior, with joy beginning to show on the surface.

baseline_models.mechanism: Hospitality for one who descends, an enclosed and shielding garden, and a promise fixed to a meeting point combine into prepared protected reception.

activation_trace.role: Prepared hospitality for a descending guest turns descent toward reception rather than mere motion.
The tree-enclosed garden gives the promised destination a sheltered, cultivated material form.
The protective shield branch adds active refuge to the garden's enclosure.
A promise bounded by time or place makes the refuge an appointed reception rather than a vague hope.

changed_reading.before: The Garden is an abstract deferred reward promised in speech.
changed_reading.after: The Garden is an appointed, already oriented place of welcome and protection toward which the angelic arrival begins the transfer.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier command directs istiqama toward God and immediately pairs it with forgiveness, so steadfastness becomes maintained orientation with repair built into it, not flawless immobility.

activation_trace.role: Uprightness and balance anchor the focus state that context specifies.
The same uprightness branch is explicitly commanded toward Him, supplying direction to the focus form.
Covering sin while protecting its bearer supplies a restorative operation adjacent to the command.

structural_cues: 41:6 uses fa-staqimu ilayhi and immediately follows it with wa-staghfiruhu.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies direction plus adjacent forgiveness; I infer that repair belongs inside steadfastness rather than proving its failure, while the live alternative is that forgiveness addresses a separate class of sins.

changed_reading.before: They attained and preserved an unbroken state of rectitude.
changed_reading.after: They kept reorienting toward their Lord along an upright line whose continuity includes seeking repair after deviation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The heavens and earth answer a divine address by saying they come willingly; this makes the focus sequence of saying and standing read as the human-scale form of a wider creaturely answer-through-alignment.

activation_trace.role: Declared belief anchors the human answer whose practical truth is at issue.
Upright alignment supplies the enacted continuation of the human answer.
Uttered speech supplies the cosmos's audible response to address.
Willing obedience makes that cosmic saying operative as compliant movement.

structural_cues: 41:11 coordinates divine address, the paired reply atayna, and the predicate ta'i'in.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel saying and willing alignment; I infer a human-cosmic analogy, while the alternative is that the verbal recurrence is only narrative and does not define istiqama.

changed_reading.before: Our Lord is Allah is a private human confession later supported by conduct.
changed_reading.after: The confession is a creaturely answer to address, and istiqama is the specifically human way of coming willingly into the order already answered by heaven and earth.

context_deltas.mechanism: Revelation is delivered downward from mercy at the opening, angels descend in the focus, and prepared hospitality follows immediately from forgiveness and mercy; the focus descent occupies the middle of one hospitable corridor.

activation_trace.role: Delivery downward makes revelation the first movement in the surah's descent sequence.
Merciful tenderness names the source-quality of the opening descent.
Angelic descent and settling form the corridor's personal middle movement.
Prepared hospitality converts the repeated root into reception for the arriving guests.
Protective covering of fault grounds the hospitality in forgiveness rather than earned entitlement.
Merciful tenderness closes the descent sequence with the same source-quality that opened it.

structural_cues: The surah opens with tanzil in 41:2 and resumes immediately after the focus with nuzulan in 41:32, bracketing tatanazzalu.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered n-z-l recurrence and matching mercy language; I infer one coordinated movement from message to messengers to reception, while the alternative keeps revelation, angelic visitation, and hospitality as independent uses.

changed_reading.before: The angelic descent is an isolated miraculous announcement inside the ayah.
changed_reading.after: It is the personal middle phase of a surah-long descent: mercy sends guidance down, accompanies those aligned with it, and receives them as protected guests.

context_deltas.mechanism: Rejecters demand that angels be sent down as externally compelling proof, but angels actually descend upon those who commit and stand; the same image reverses from demanded spectacle to intimate assurance.

activation_trace.role: Requested delivery downward supplies the rejected party's proposed test of the messengers.
Angels are the demanded visible agents in that counterfactual test.
Covering the truth marks the posture from which the demand is issued.
Actual descent and settling answer the earlier demand in a different relational setting.
The same class of agents now addresses steadfast recipients rather than coercing rejecters.

structural_cues: 41:14 places la-anzala mala'ikatan inside a rejecting objection; 41:30 states tatanazzalu alayhimu al-mala'ikatu as realized action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an unrealized demand and a later realized descent; I infer a reversal from public proof to relational accompaniment, while the live alternative is that the two descents refer to unrelated occasions or thresholds.

changed_reading.before: Angels descend because steadfast believers qualify for a supernatural reward.
changed_reading.after: The descent also answers the surah's earlier angel-demand by relocating disclosure: angels are not furnished to bypass trust, but become companions of a trust already embodied.

context_deltas.mechanism: Assigned companions bind themselves to people and beautify what lies before and behind them; immediately after the focus, the descending speakers identify themselves as near, managing allies across worldly and later life, replacing distortion with protective accompaniment.

activation_trace.role: A companion joined to another supplies the corrupt accompaniment operating before the focus.
Making something appear beautiful supplies that accompaniment's perceptual distortion.
The descending angels anchor the identity of the new speakers and companions.
Taking charge of an affair makes their nearness an active, protective accompaniment.
Love, support, and alliance supply the benevolent quality opposite the earlier companions' distortion.

structural_cues: 41:25 spans ma bayna aydihim wa-ma khalfahum, while 41:31 spans al-hayati al-dunya wa-fi al-akhirah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two opposed forms of companionship and two extended spans; I infer an exchange or exposure of allegiances, while the alternative is that the angels announce guardianship that was always present rather than replacing anything.

changed_reading.before: The angels arrive briefly to deliver reassurance.
changed_reading.after: Their descent discloses a durable counter-companionship: steadfastness changes who mediates one's field of perception and who remains near across both lives.

context_deltas.mechanism: The passage after the focus tests excellent speech by invitation, right action, peaceful identity, pushing away evil with what is better, and patient restraint; istiqama becomes relational work that converts hostility rather than private stasis.

activation_trace.role: A declared belief anchors the speech that the following passage tests in action.
Resolve and rising to an undertaking make istiqama active rather than inert.
Sincere care for something makes good speech a committed concern, not rhetorical display.
Calling and inclining another by speech turns the declaration outward as invitation.
Doing the beautiful supplies the positive material used against an evil relation.
Removing a harmful thing supplies the forceful but non-retaliatory operation on hostility.
Holding the self back from panic supplies the discipline that keeps the better response available.

structural_cues: 41:33 couples best speech with calling, doing right, and saying I am of those who submit; 41:34-35 then gives a conflict operation and its patience condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an immediate sequence from speech to practice and transformed enmity; I infer that it unfolds the focus's istiqama, while the alternative treats it as a new exhortation with no retrospective definition of 41:30.

changed_reading.before: Steadfastness is mainly preserving one's own confession under pressure.
changed_reading.after: It is the repeatable craft of making confession socially true: inviting, acting well, absorbing provocation without mirroring it, and opening the possibility that an enemy becomes a close ally.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing human portrait swings from tireless demand for good to severed hope under a touch of harm, then from blessing to withdrawal; against this foil, istiqama is a non-transactional relation that survives changing states, and no fear or grief removes the swing's affective motors.

activation_trace.role: Upright balance anchors the stable posture sharpened by the later oscillations.
Expected harm names one forward-driving force from which the stable posture is released.
Psychic roughness under grief names the complementary burden from which it is released.
A mere impact reaching the person supplies the small event that triggers the surrounding collapse.
Severed hope supplies the first extreme of the harm-triggered reaction.
A second severing of hope intensifies the collapse rather than balancing it.
Good condition and blessing supply the opposite circumstance that nonetheless triggers relational withdrawal.
Drawing one's side away supplies the bodily geometry of blessing-conditioned estrangement.

structural_cues: 41:49-51 repeatedly alternate good, mercy, harm, and blessing through conditional turns, while the person's claim, despair, prayer, and withdrawal change with the condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a late portrait of state-dependent reaction; I read it as a foil to istiqama because of the shared surah and sharp posture contrast, while the alternative is that it indicts ingratitude without defining the steadfast group.

changed_reading.before: Steadfastness means holding correct belief despite external opposition.
changed_reading.after: It also means refusing to make lordship contingent on felt fortune: neither harm severs hope nor blessing produces entitled withdrawal, so fear and grief no longer govern the relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same q-w-m inventory moves from uprightness now to the Day of Rising and the denied standing Hour; present istiqama becomes an anticipatory way of standing that corresponds to secure arrival then.

activation_trace.role: Present uprightness anchors the ethical posture from which the temporal bridge begins.
A heart settled in security supplies the contrasting mode of arrival on the Day.
Resurrection and the rising of the Hour move the root's standing image to the final horizon.
The claim that the Hour is not standing supplies the explicit denial opposed to anticipatory uprightness.

structural_cues: 41:40 contrasts being cast into fire with coming secure on yawm al-qiyamah; 41:50 voices doubt that al-sa'ata qa'imah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated q-w-m forms with ethical and eschatological branches; I infer that uprightness rehearses future standing, while the alternative keeps istiqama and qiyamah as conventional senses without a functional bridge.

changed_reading.before: Istiqama secures a reward that will be received at resurrection.
changed_reading.after: Istiqama is already a mode of resurrection-facing standing: the believer embodies now the stability of the Day the reactive speaker denies, so the angelic assurance names secure continuity between the two standings.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses angelic and ecological descent and uses the packet's split r-b-b/r-b-w mapping. It remains anchored by the exact n-z-l recurrence, focus Rabb branch inventory, and first-sign branch of b-sh-r. Downstream prose should mark it as a rain-and-growth analogy, not an etymology of Rabb or a claim that angels are rain.

activation_trace.role: Nourishment and growth provide an exploratory developmental resonance inside the packet's split mapping for Rabb.
Delivery downward anchors the angelic movement that the later rain scene reimages.
First signs or shoots make glad tidings the visible beginning of a promised state.
Water delivered downward supplies the ecological analogue for the focus descent.
Earth and vegetation stirring with life supply the response to descent.
Increase and rising supply the upward answer to what came down.
Earth's life through rain completes the revivifying material analogy.

changed_reading.before: Angels descend to communicate a settled promise to already steadfast people.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their descent behaves like life-giving rain: what comes down elicits an answering rise, and glad tidings are the first visible growth of the promised life.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it builds a spatial montage across adjacent ayat rather than a direct gloss. It remains anchored to the focus's q-w-m uprightness and n-z-l downward motion, set immediately after feet and lowness in 41:29. Downstream prose should call it a compositional vertical contrast, not a lexical equivalence or certain intended symbolism.

activation_trace.role: The trampling foot supplies the preceding scene's instrument of forced vertical abasement.
Low place beneath height supplies the destination wished for the misleaders.
Bodily standing supplies the focus's immediate counter-posture to forced lowness.
Upright balance turns that counter-posture into moral-spatial integrity.
Descent from above reverses the prior wish to push others down: help comes down upon those who stand.

changed_reading.before: The ayah simply contrasts faithful people with the condemned speakers before them.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it reverses the preceding vertical economy: instead of securing oneself by putting others beneath one's feet, one stands upright and receives a descent from above.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps the repeated spatial front-and-rear construction onto fear's anticipated future and grief's retained past. It remains anchored in the focus affect words and in the packet's 41:25/41:42 flank repetition. Downstream prose should qualify future/past as a reader-supplied temporal analogy, since the packet also supports ordinary spatial and social readings.

activation_trace.role: Expectation of harm supplies the threatened forward temporal flank.
Psychic roughness from grief supplies the burdened rear temporal flank.
Making things appear beautiful supplies the companions' distortion across the flanking field.
The idiomatic between-the-hands branch supplies the front flank that distortion occupies.
What lies behind supplies the paired rear flank under distortion.
Departure from truth and stability identifies what cannot penetrate the protected field.
The repeated front-flank construction supplies one side of revelation's inaccessibility to falsehood.
The repeated rear-flank branch completes revelation's protected surround.

changed_reading.before: Do not fear and do not grieve removes two private negative emotions.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the assurance guards both temporal flanks: anticipated harm ahead and grief retained behind no longer let distorting companions rewrite the believer's horizon, in analogy with revelation's protected front and rear.

strongest_changes: The ordered n-z-l chain turns angelic descent into the middle phase of revelation, accompaniment, and prepared hospitality.
The 41:14/41:30 reversal relocates angels from demanded public spectacle to intimate assurance for trust already embodied.
The 41:25/41:31 contrast changes the descent from a brief message into durable counter-companionship.
The 41:49-51 foil recasts istiqama as freedom from blessing-and-harm oscillation, while q-w-m recurrence lets present uprightness anticipate secure resurrection standing.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah order creates lexical and structural reversals around the focus: repeated sayings are tested by trajectory, descent changes from demanded sign to merciful reception, and companionship, verticality, practice, and affective time converge without requiring one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not settle when the angelic descent occurs or whether it names one threshold or repeated accompaniment.
The cosmic-answer and resurrection-standing links are coherent root-and-sequence activations but may exceed deliberate inter-ayah linkage.
The rain-growth reading depends partly on a split mapped root, and the vertical and temporal-flank readings are compositional analogies that require explicit exploratory qualification.
